landing.headline: Master every foundation before unlocking what comes next.
landing.subheadline: Smart-Tech replaces flat topic checklists with a verified prerequisite graph. Learners prove mastery through quizzes, follow shortest valid study paths, and keep every progress record intact when instructors restructure courses.
landing.howItWorksDesc: Three deterministic graph guarantees built into every course.
landing.pillar1Desc: Instructors connect concepts with directed prerequisites while backend cycle detection prevents circular deadlocks.
landing.pillar2Desc: Completing a reading does not unlock advanced modules alone. Passing each quiz above the threshold unlocks dependent concepts.
landing.pillar3Desc: Pick any target concept like Algorithms or Recursion. Smart-Tech computes the minimal ordered route skipping mastered topics.
landing.demoAccountsDesc: Launch immediately as an instructor or test three distinct learner mastery profiles.
landing.catalogDesc: Enroll as a learner or inspect the live concept map.

auth.quickDemoHint: Click any profile below to sign in instantly (password: demo123).
auth.errorGeneric: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials.

learner.dashboardSubtitle: Track concept mastery, follow personalized learning paths, and stay synced with curriculum updates.
learner.noEnrollments: You have not enrolled in any courses yet.
learner.noEnrollmentsHint: Choose a course below to unlock your prerequisite map and start studying.
learner.noNotifications: No notifications yet. Curriculum updates will appear here.

courseLearn.enrollPrompt: Enroll in this course to track mastery, unlock concepts, and generate learning paths.
courseLearn.selectConceptHint: Select any concept node to study its lesson or inspect missing prerequisites.
courseLearn.lockedExplain: "{{concept}}" is locked because you have not yet mastered: {{missing}}.
courseLearn.needsReviewNote: Note: A new prerequisite ({{missing}}) was added after you mastered this concept. Your mastery record is preserved, and you may review the new prerequisite anytime.
courseLearn.lessonBeforeQuizHint: Note: Marking a lesson completed records your reading progress, while passing the quiz below proves mastery.
courseLearn.passedMsg: Mastery achieved! Dependent concepts have been recalculated.
courseLearn.failedMsg: Score below {{threshold}}% threshold. Review the explanations below and retry.
courseLearn.preservedHistoryDesc: Your past quiz achievements remain permanently preserved even after curriculum restructuring:

learningPath.title: Personalized Learning Path
learningPath.subtitle: Select any target concept to compute the minimal valid study sequence skipping concepts you have already mastered.
learningPath.noneCompleted: No prerequisites mastered along this branch yet.
learningPath.allDone: You have mastered this target concept and all of its prerequisites.

instructor.dashboardSubtitle: Design prerequisite graphs, author lessons and quizzes, and restructure live courses safely.

graphEditor.title: Prerequisite Graph & Live Restructuring
graphEditor.subtitle: Connect concepts as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). Cycles are blocked on the backend, and learners stay notified with progress intact.
graphEditor.clickConnectHint: Tip: Select a node on the canvas to highlight its prerequisites and dependents, or use the link builder.
graphEditor.edgeAddedSuccess: Prerequisite link added. Affected learners recalculated and notified.
graphEditor.edgeRemovedSuccess: Prerequisite link removed. Affected learners recalculated and notified.
graphEditor.splitModalDesc: Divide "{{title}}" into smaller concepts. Original learner quiz scores and mastery records remain archived and preserved; new modules require fresh mastery verification.
graphEditor.migrationPolicyDefault: Original concept records and quiz scores remain preserved in learner history. Newly created split concepts start unmastered and require passing their quizzes.
graphEditor.splitSuccess: Concept split completed. {{count}} enrolled learners notified with historical records preserved.

notifMessages.welcome_path: Your personalized learning path to {{target}} is ready. Master {{next}} to unlock downstream concepts.
notifMessages.progress_milestone: You have mastered {{mastered}} of {{total}} concepts. Downstream modules are unlocked.
notifMessages.prereq_added: A new prerequisite ("{{prerequisite}}") was added before "{{dependent}}". Your learning path has been updated while preserving all existing progress.
notifMessages.prereq_removed: The prerequisite "{{prerequisite}}" before "{{dependent}}" was removed. Unlocked concepts and learning paths have been recalculated.
notifMessages.concept_split: The concept "{{original}}" was divided into smaller learning sections ({{newConcepts}}). Previous quiz results remain preserved; new sections require mastery verification.
